title: On the largest strongly connected component of randomly oriented divisor graphs
summary: We introduce the study of \textit{randomly oriented divisor graphs}. For each $ρ\in [0,1]$, the randomly oriented divisor graph $\mathcal{D}_ρ(N)$ is obtained from the divisor graph on $\{1, 2, \ldots, N\}$ by directing each edge according to divisibility and independently reversing the direction of each edge with probability $ρ$. We study the expected size of the largest strongly connected component, $\textbf{E}[\#Φ(\mathcal{D}_ρ(N))]$.
